item.text: [{"task_id":"1a244afd~v","source_lines":["def match_pairs(anchors, markers, alignment):","    if len(anchors) == 0:","        return (0, [])","    best = None","    r, c = anchors[0]","    for i in range(len(markers)):","        mr, mc = markers[i]","        dr, dc = mr - r, mc - c","        if dr != alignment and dc != alignment:","            continue","        remaining = markers[:i] + markers[i + 1:]","        result = match_pairs(anchors[1:], remaining, alignment)","        if result is None:","            continue","        cost = abs(dr) + abs(dc) + result[0]","        if best is None or cost < best[0]:","            best = (cost, [(r, c, dr, dc)] + result[1])","    return best","def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    anchor = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    target = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    alignment = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    a = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    b = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))","    c = int(round(params['geometry'][3]))","    d = int(round(params['geometry'][4]))","    anchors = np.argwhere(grid == anchor).tolist()","    markers = np.argwhere(grid == marker).tolist()","    result = match_pairs(anchors, markers, alignment)","    out = grid.copy()","    if result is None:","        return out","    out[grid == marker] = background","    height, width = grid.shape","    for r, col, dr, dc in result[1]:","        nr = r + a * dr + b * dc","        nc = col + c * dr + d * dc","        if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width:","            out[nr, nc] = target","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"geometry":[5]},"params":{"colors":[1,4,9,2],"geometry":[0,0,1,-1,0]},"rationale":"Pair yellow anchors with aligned maroon markers using the minimum total distance one-to-one assignment. Remove maroon markers and rotate each anchor-to-marker displacement clockwise by 90 degrees, placing a red pixel at the resulting position when it falls inside the grid. Colors, alignment, and rotation are encoded in the tensors."}]
